title: The Drowned Chapel
text: A chapel roof sticks out of the marsh, its bell tower leaning, its doors under black water. Inside, the water is perfectly clear. Far below, candles burn on the altar beside a silver plate, and the drowned congregation sits in the pews, heads bowed.

options.label: The hardiest dives for the altar plate.

outcomes.text: They come up gasping, silver in their arms, and the congregation never lifts its heads.
Something down there holds on, and a bowed head turns to look at them.

options.label: Pray from the roof with the drowned.

outcomes.text: The candles flare, and the marsh is quieter for a while.
The candles watch you go. One goes out as you turn away, and the Leader feels it go out in them too.
The candles watch you go, and their light lies on the Leader's face all the next day like a hand of blessing.

options.label: The Abjurer wards their breath and dives for the altar.

outcomes.text: They come up with a candle that does not go out under water.
They come up after a long time, with nothing, and something of the chapel in their eyes.
